FVTTMB.Menu.ConnectHint: Show the address and QR code for the Foundry Mobile companion app.
FVTTMB.Connect.Intro: Scan this code with your phone, or open the address below in a mobile browser. The phone must be able to reach this Foundry server.
FVTTMB.Connect.Note: A browser client with this module must stay online: it prepares sheet data and rolls dice with real system rules.
FVTTMB.Setting.EnabledHint: Answer requests from mobile clients. Turn off to block the app entirely.
FVTTMB.Setting.AllowRollsHint: When off, phones can read sheets but cannot roll.
FVTTMB.Setting.RequireOwnershipHint: When off, observers may also open a sheet on their phone (read-only data).
FVTTMB.Setting.ExecutorModeHint: Which browser does the work for phones. Leave on automatic unless you are debugging.
FVTTMB.Setting.VerboseHint: Write every bridge request to the browser console.
FVTTMB.Setting.AllowEditsHint: When off, phones can roll and read the sheet but cannot change anything on it.
FVTTMB.Setting.AllowlistHint: Only these users may use the app (names or ids, comma-separated). Leave empty to allow everyone.
FVTTMB.Setting.AssignedOnlyHint: Players may act only for the character assigned to them, even if they own other actors. GMs are unaffected.
FVTTMB.Setting.RateLimitHint: Most changing actions a phone may make in 10 seconds. 0 turns the limit off.
FVTTMB.Setting.AuditHint: Whisper a GM-only line whenever a phone changes something, so you can see what players do remotely.
FVTTMB.Reject.NotAllowed: Your account is not on this world's allowlist for the mobile app.
FVTTMB.Reject.RateLimited: Too many actions from the app in a short time — please slow down.
